error.itemCodeTooLong: Item code must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.descriptionTooLong: Description must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.unitTooLong: Unit must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.quantity: Quantity must be a number above 0 (up to 3 decimals).

contractLines.keyHint: Unique for each line. A line whose reference is already on this contract is skipped.
contractLines.lineNoHint: Optional. Sets the order of the lines; lines without one come last.
contractLines.earningBasisHint: Optional. Unit rate (quantity × rate) or lump sum (one amount, quantity 1).
contractLines.existingUnavailable: Could not check for lines already on this contract. Any line already there will be skipped at import.
contractLines.nothingNew: Nothing to import: every valid line is already on this contract.
